title: Radiation Protection Physicist / Engineer
about: The Paul Scherrer Institut (PSI) is recruiting a Radiation Protection Physicist / Engineer for a fixed-term project position. Applications are due 4 January 2027 via PSI's job portal.
card_alt: Card for the Radiation Protection Physicist / Engineer position at Paul Scherrer Institut (PSI), Villigen, Switzerland; deadline 4 Jan 2027. The photo shows the Matterhorn above the village of Zermatt with a Swiss flag, in Switzerland but not in Villigen.
